# Error codes

<!-- Generated by AIMDDS scripts/generate_error_doc.py. Do not edit. -->

Canonical definitions from `apps.system.errors.ERRORS_BY_CODE` in AIMDDS.
This reference contains **170 definitions**.
Edit the AIMDDS definitions and regenerate this file to change the catalog.

Severity values are `GOOD=0`, `WARNING=1`, `ERROR=2`, and `CRITICAL=3`.
A code describes a fault; active/acknowledged state and diagnostic details
belong to individual occurrences. Acknowledgment does not clear a fault.

The registry reserves 5500–5999 for Zygo and 6000–6499 for the engraver;
reserved ranges are not implemented controller definitions.

| MAXIMA | 4000-4999 | 35 |
| SPHINX | 5000-5499 | 19 |

## HELIX (1000-1999)

### Experiment Settings (1000-1049)

Source: `apps.system.errors.helix.experiment_settings`.

#### 1010 — Invalid flyer stack configuration {#error-1010}

**Severity:** WARNING (1)

**Source:** HELIX: Experiment settings

**Recommended action:** Provide the flyer stack as a valid configuration object containing the expected flyer metadata.

#### 1011 — Invalid flyer material {#error-1011}

**Severity:** WARNING (1)

**Source:** HELIX: Experiment settings

**Recommended action:** Provide the flyer material as a string.

#### 1012 — Invalid flyer thickness {#error-1012}

**Severity:** WARNING (1)

**Source:** HELIX: Experiment settings

**Recommended action:** Provide the flyer thickness as an integer.

#### 1020 — Invalid pulse points configuration {#error-1020}

**Severity:** WARNING (1)

**Source:** HELIX: Experiment settings

**Recommended action:** Provide pulse points as a sequence of integer \(row, column\) pairs within the supported flyer grid.

#### 1021 — Duplicate pulse points specified {#error-1021}

**Severity:** WARNING (1)

**Source:** HELIX: Experiment settings

**Recommended action:** Provide each flyer position only once. Duplicate positions are removed while preserving the first occurrence.

#### 1030 — Invalid waveplate angles configuration {#error-1030}

**Severity:** WARNING (1)

**Source:** HELIX: Experiment settings

**Recommended action:** Provide waveplate angles as a sequence of finite numeric values.

#### 1031 — Waveplate angles are out of allowable bounds {#error-1031}

**Severity:** WARNING (1)

**Source:** HELIX: Experiment settings

**Recommended action:** Provide waveplate angles within the supported range. Values outside the range are clamped to the nearest allowable bound.

#### 1040 — Invalid PDV probes configuration {#error-1040}

**Severity:** WARNING (1)

**Source:** HELIX: Experiment settings

**Recommended action:** Provide PDV probe numbers as integers corresponding to configured PDV probes.

#### 1041 — Duplicate PDV probes specified {#error-1041}

**Severity:** WARNING (1)

**Source:** HELIX: Experiment settings

**Recommended action:** Provide each PDV probe only once. Duplicate probes are removed while preserving the first occurrence.

Source: `apps.system.errors.helix.heating_laser`.

#### 1051 — Heating laser connection failed {#error-1051}

**Severity:** ERROR (2)

### Motion Stage (1100-1149)

Source: `apps.system.errors.helix.motion_stage`.

#### 1101 — Motion stage connection failed {#error-1101}

**Severity:** ERROR (2)

**Source:** HELIX: Motion stage

**Recommended action:** Verify that the motion stage is powered on, connected to the control network, and reachable at its configured address.

#### 1110 — Motion stage motors failed to enable {#error-1110}

**Severity:** ERROR (2)

**Source:** HELIX: Motion stage

**Recommended action:** Clear any motion stage faults, verify that the axes can be enabled, and confirm that all interlocks permit motion.

#### 1111 — Motion stage motors failed to disable {#error-1111}

**Severity:** CRITICAL (3)

**Source:** HELIX: Motion stage

#### 1120 — Motion stage move request failed {#error-1120}

**Severity:** ERROR (2)

**Source:** HELIX: Motion stage

**Recommended action:** Verify motion stage communication, clear controller faults, and confirm that the requested destination is permitted.

#### 1121 — Motion stage failed to reach its destination {#error-1121}

**Severity:** ERROR (2)

**Source:** HELIX: Motion stage

**Recommended action:** Inspect the stage for an obstruction or axis fault and verify that the requested position can be reached safely.

### UR10e (1400-1449)

Source: `apps.system.errors.helix.ur10e`.

#### 1401 — UR10e connection failed {#error-1401}

**Severity:** ERROR (2)

**Source:** HELIX: UR10e

**Recommended action:** Verify that the UR10e is powered on, in remote control mode, connected to the control network, and reachable at its configured address.

#### 1410 — UR10e assembly request failed {#error-1410}

**Severity:** ERROR (2)

**Source:** HELIX: UR10e

**Recommended action:** Inspect the robot state before retrying. The assembly request may have been received even though its acknowledgment was not confirmed.

#### 1411 — UR10e assembly failed to start {#error-1411}

**Severity:** ERROR (2)

**Source:** HELIX: UR10e

#### 1412 — UR10e assembly failed to complete {#error-1412}

**Severity:** ERROR (2)

#### 1420 — UR10e disassembly request failed {#error-1420}

**Severity:** CRITICAL (3)

**Recommended action:** Inspect the robot and package state before retrying. The disassembly request may have been received even though it was not confirmed.

#### 1421 — UR10e disassembly failed to start {#error-1421}

**Severity:** CRITICAL (3)

**Source:** HELIX: UR10e

#### 1422 — UR10e disassembly failed to complete {#error-1422}

**Severity:** CRITICAL (3)

**Source:** HELIX: UR10e

**Recommended action:** Keep personnel clear and inspect the robot and package state. Complete disassembly using the approved recovery procedure.

#### 4810 — Robot in protective stop {#error-4810}

**Severity:** CRITICAL (3)

**Source:** MAXIMA: Internal robot

**Recommended action:** Turn off the xrays if on and close the shutter if open. Open the sample front door. Recover the robot via the Teach pendant: Click the "Enable robot" button. Hold the black button at the top of the Teach pendant to put the robot in free drive and move it towards yourself. Hold the sample, and use the "UR+" button in the upper right corner to release the gripper. Close the sample front door. Open the autodoor and place the sample back in the holder. Close the autodoor. Turn the xrays on and open the shutter if necessary. Press the play button on the robot.

#### 4820 — Robot has part {#error-4820}

**Severity:** ERROR (2)

**Source:** MAXIMA: Internal robot

**Recommended action:** No action is specified in the registry.

## SPHINX (5000-5499)

### InView (5000-5099)

Source: `apps.system.errors.sphinx.inview`.

#### 5001 — InView is unreachable or not ready {#error-5001}

**Severity:** ERROR (2)

**Source:** SPHINX: InView

**Recommended action:** Confirm that InView is running, reachable, and idle. The controller will continue automatically when InView is ready.

#### 5002 — InView status is unavailable {#error-5002}

**Severity:** ERROR (2)

**Source:** SPHINX: InView

**Recommended action:** Check the InView application and network connection. The controller will retry the status request automatically.

#### 5003 — InView command failed {#error-5003}

**Severity:** ERROR (2)

**Source:** SPHINX: InView

**Recommended action:** Review the InView state and any displayed prompt or error. The controller will retry the command automatically.

### Motion Stage (5100-5199)

Source: `apps.system.errors.sphinx.motion_stage`.

#### 5101 — Stage failed to reach its requested position {#error-5101}

**Severity:** ERROR (2)

**Source:** SPHINX: Motion stage

**Recommended action:** Check InView and inspect the stage for an obstruction or motion fault. The controller will continue after the target is verified.

#### 5102 — Stage position could not be verified {#error-5102}

**Severity:** ERROR (2)

**Source:** SPHINX: Motion stage

**Recommended action:** Confirm the measured stage position in InView. Automatic motion will remain paused until the requested position is verified.

### Indentation (5200-5299)

Source: `apps.system.errors.sphinx.indentation`.

#### 5201 — InView indentation configuration failed {#error-5201}

**Severity:** ERROR (2)

**Source:** SPHINX: Indentation

**Recommended action:** Review the InView multisample configuration and method file. The controller will retry the rejected command automatically.

#### 5202 — InView did not start the configured indentation test {#error-5202}

**Severity:** ERROR (2)

**Source:** SPHINX: Indentation

**Recommended action:** Check the configured test in InView and resolve any instrument prompt or configuration error. The controller will retry automatically.

#### 5204 — Indentation test exceeded its expected maximum runtime {#error-5204}

**Severity:** ERROR (2)

**Source:** SPHINX: Indentation

**Recommended action:** Inspect the active test in InView. The controller will continue monitoring until the test completes.

#### 5205 — Completed indentation project cleanup failed {#error-5205}

**Severity:** ERROR (2)

**Source:** SPHINX: Indentation

**Recommended action:** Check the multisample project and status in InView. Automatic egress remains blocked while the controller retries cleanup.

#### 5250 — Invalid indentation points configuration {#error-5250}

**Severity:** WARNING (1)

**Source:** SPHINX: Indentation

**Recommended action:** Provide sample-holder points as a non-empty sequence of finite numeric \(x, y\) pairs in millimeters. Default points were used.

#### 5251 — Invalid indentation settings configuration {#error-5251}

**Severity:** WARNING (1)

**Source:** SPHINX: Indentation

**Recommended action:** Provide indentation\_settings as an object containing the required station settings. Default indentation settings were used.

#### 5252 — Invalid indentation Z position {#error-5252}

**Severity:** WARNING (1)

**Source:** SPHINX: Indentation

**Recommended action:** Provide z\_pos as a finite numeric value in meters. The default Z position was used.

#### 5253 — Invalid indentation method file {#error-5253}

**Severity:** WARNING (1)

**Source:** SPHINX: Indentation

**Recommended action:** Provide method\_file as a non-empty InView method path. The default method file was used.

#### 5254 — Invalid indentation method inputs {#error-5254}

**Severity:** WARNING (1)

**Source:** SPHINX: Indentation

**Recommended action:** Provide method\_inputs as an object of InView input names and values. Default method inputs were used.

#### 5301 — Vacuum sensor reading failed {#error-5301}
